item.description:
Workbench 2.4.0

Keep dictation, capture and presentation controls close to the work you are doing.

  • A clearer floating toolbar. The three-dot menu is gone. Each tool shows its next action, and Switch tool keeps running jobs and their controls together.
  • A live Persona camera bubble. Show a mirrored webcam over your other apps, with Start, Hide, Show again and End controls. Nothing is recorded by the bubble; camera availability depends on other apps using the device.
  • Pick up unfinished captures. Snap & Talk brings capture, narration and review into one workspace. Review unfinished Snap reopens its draft directly, and a narration that hears nothing keeps the screenshot.
  • More useful speech controls. Meetings has its own page with Pause and Stop & transcribe. Sublime dictation uses one guarded paste and keeps your words copied; a changed or unreadable destination retains the copied fallback.
  • Consistent everyday actions. Timer uses the same Start, Pause, Resume and Stop controls across surfaces. Stop drawing closes a whiteboard while keeping its ink, and microphone-refusal messages offer the relevant settings shortcut.

Choose Settings → Workbench updates when you are ready. Your saved work stays in this edition’s library.

First download: unzip Workbench, move it to Applications in your home folder, then open it there. When replacing an existing copy, quit it and use the same Applications folder.

Fresh-Mac setup, macOS 14/15, camera sharing with Zoom, camera disconnect/permission changes, additional displays and full VoiceOver were not newly certified for this release. Remaining click-through refinements stay in issue #134; this release does not claim every physical-input scenario passed.

Workbench 2.3.1

Open Workbench and pick up where you left off.

  • A clearer place to start. Home brings Dictate, Snap, Snap & Talk and recent work together. Continue an explanation from its card, or collapse the sidebar for more room.
  • Make images say more. View and edit images in one resizable workspace. Add text, crop to a slide shape, move marks, rotate, undo, copy and export while keeping the original.
  • Capture from the toolbar. Choose Region, Window or Screen directly in Snap and a prepared Snap & Talk session. The floating controls stay upright at screen edges, reveal clear icons and show shortcut hints.
  • Put yourself in the picture. Choose a photo for your local Me profile, adjust its appearance and use it as a Persona when you present. Your previous scene artwork stays intact.

Choose Settings → Workbench updates when you’re ready. Your saved work stays in this edition’s library.

Image compatibility. Images saved with text or rotation use Snap format 2 and need this update or a newer release. The first promotion keeps the previous metadata as a backup; original and earlier rendered image files are preserved.

Workbench 2.3.1

A calmer Mac toolbar and clearer navigation, with fixes for captured work, reading and Persona controls.

  • A quiet resting handle, compact contextual controls and Tab / Shift-Tab navigation.
  • Recording, playback and results share one floating host. Starting independent activities preserves pending dictation recovery and clipboard receipts.
  • A smaller Home with current work and recent History, pinned Settings and one Floating toolbar switch.
  • Clearer Persona selection and shown states, portrait drafts and Circle / Card / Original appearance.
  • Read preserves its draft when copied text is rejected, and timer menus act only on the step they displayed.

For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Your saved work stays in this edition's library.
